title: purple-mimi 2: decide the plugin's protocol to mimid
description: Design decision for Mark, with a recommendation. Options: (a) plugin speaks mimid-agent's local JMAP Chat (HTTP+EventSource; JSON); (b) plugin embeds mimid-agent-core via a C ABI and talks JMAP-MIMI to the provider itself (plugin is the MLS client; Rust in-process); (c) a new small local agent protocol (CBOR or JSON over a unix socket) as a front end over the store, like IRC; (d) none: document using Pidgin's built-in IRC/XMPP plugins against mimid's front ends. Cover effort, crash safety (the store/outbox), multiple clients at once, packaging, and which keeps the agent the only MLS end. Record in docs/design/purple-mimi.md §2.
